name: 素灰·清水
description: 源自 rico-md 的「素灰·清水」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 20px 50px 20px; font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 2; color: {{text}}; background-color: #f2f2f0; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: 0.02em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 300; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 28px 0 18px; padding-bottom: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c0bfb8; letter-spacing: 0.15em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; color: {{muted}}; line-height: 1.6; margin: 24px 0 14px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid #d5d4ce; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d4ce; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5)">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: {{muted}}; line-height: 1.7; margin: 22px 0 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #5a5a5a; line-height: 1.8; margin: 18px 0 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #d5d4ce; font-weight: 400; color: {{muted}}; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11.5px">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 28px auto; border: none; width: 48px; height: 1px; background-color: #c0bfb8">
